correctness.rationale: Exact coordinate substitution gives a two-sheet fold with determinant -(1+x+y). Each sheet is injectively mapped to a rectifiable-boundary domain; uniform translated-grid counting and changes of variables prove the all-target main term and \(O(t)\) remainder. Exact area \(13/3\) and the weighted inverse-seed Riemann-sum limit are derived. The standalone fully rational checker certifies exactly 43 interior and 13 boundary preimages at t=10, split 49/7 by fold side; finite computation is not used for infinite asymptotics. The large-gain limit is a legitimate formula continuation beyond the original finite numerical gain window, not an empirical claim within that window.

This gives a complete all-target high-frequency law, a sharp loss by factor two on each target-edge coordinate, a nonuniform universal inverse-seed spatial density and \(25:1\) fold-sheet asymmetry, plus a completely certified finite count at the published baseline. It neither repeats routine numerical trajectories nor implies unjustified security properties.
